title: Comparison constant at one half
statement: Let $C(\lambda)$ equal $e$ when $\lambda=1/2$, and equal $((1-\lambda)/\lambda)^{1/(2(1-2\lambda))}$ otherwise, with the real-power conventions in its definition. As $\lambda$ tends to $1/2$ from below through values in $(0,1/2)$, $C(\lambda)$ tends to $e$.
hypotheses_covered: The comparison constant is defined for real $\lambda$ by the stated piecewise formula
The limit is taken as $\lambda\to 1/2$ within $0<\lambda<1/2$
